description: This script updates Node.js version references in build scripts and Dockerfiles within a project directory. It fetches the latest Node.js LTS version, updates relevant files accordingly, and handles multiple Dockerfile paths.

methods.name: getDockerfilePaths
methods.description: Reads a directory and returns paths to Dockerfiles starting with 'Dockerfile'.

methods.name: getLatestNodeJsVersion
methods.description: Fetches the latest Node.js LTS version from the official Node.js distribution JSON.

methods.name: replaceVersionInFile
methods.description: Replaces the version string in a specified file based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: refreshBuildScriptVersionNumber
methods.description: Updates the Node.js version in the build script file.

methods.name: refreshDockerfileVersionNumber
methods.description: Updates the Node.js version in a Dockerfile.
